title: FXItems
description: WARNING: Coding Involved | Framework for adding custom Items, Events, Commands and Foods
body:
FXItems is a powerful and modular plugin built for Spigot and PaperMC servers, designed for server owners and developers who are comfortable with Java coding. It serves as a flexible framework for creating custom items, foods, commands, and unique abilities in Minecraft. Unlike drag-and-drop plugins or configuration-based item packs, FXItems is a developer toolkit: you extend it by writing your own Java classes for new content, then register them using the plugin’s robust registry system. This means you can craft entirely new gameplay mechanics, legendary items, food with special effects, and much more—all tailored to your server’s vision.

With FXItems, you get a clean, extensible architecture: add new items, foods, abilities, and commands simply by creating a Java class and plugging it in. Sample classes and comprehensive utility libraries are included to get you started, covering cooldown systems, mana bars, projectile handling, potion effects, teleportation, and more. The plugin also supports advanced features like one-time crafting for legendary items, per-player cooldowns, and easy integration with other plugins such as EntitySize or ModelEngine for even greater flexibility.

It’s important to note that FXItems is meant for those with Java programming experience or access to a developer. There is no GUI, config-based editor, or in-game designer—your creativity is unlocked through code. If you’re looking for the ultimate toolkit to build your own custom Minecraft RPG items, abilities, and mechanics, and you (or your team) are comfortable writing Java, FXItems is the perfect foundation for your next Minecraft project.

Check the Github Documentation for all information. This is currently in Beta and is Open Source. Source Code and Download:
https://github.com/Noctify0/FXItems

I would really appreciate people trying to code with this plugin. Please try and Report all the bugs to me so I can improve this plugin. If you have any ideas on what I can add to the plugin for example other Utilities and extra Framework to be able to create more custom things, PLEASE tell me on Github.

Thank you.
